//: Copy to ~/.blaude/config.json (or ./blaude.config.json) and edit. Every field is optional; defaults live in src/config.mjs and src/policy.mjs.

models.//mlx-example: Once you have an MLX server running, point the default at it:

policy.//mode: local-only | claude-audits | claude-first. The old names local-first and split still resolve.
policy.//source: usage-command reads exact percentages from `claude /usage` (free). claude-code estimates from transcripts. gateway counts only what Blaude forwarded.
policy.//floors: Minimum allowance that must REMAIN for this purpose to use Claude. Accepts 20, 0.2 or "20%". "never" (or a bare 1, or 100) means never — so write one percent as "1%", never as 1.
policy.//limits: Only used by the fallback estimator and the simulator; `blaude calibrate --write` fills these in.
policy.//cloudTransport: cli uses the official claude CLI (your subscription). api uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and costs credits.
policy.//handoff: Never switch destination mid-turn: re-caching a long conversation on Claude is expensive, so the switch lands on the next prompt.
policy.//capabilityRouting: Send a request to Claude when the local model cannot serve it at all, on its own bounded floor.

//thinking: strip drops reasoning traces; text folds them into the reply.
//localTools: Which tool definitions reach a local model. Claude Code sends ~27,500 tokens of them across 25 tools, and the largest are orchestration a local model never calls. mode 'core' keeps a coding core, 'all' sends everything; `also` adds names or globs, e.g. ["mcp__github__*"].
//simpleSystemPrompt: Ask Claude Code for its abbreviated system prompt and tool descriptions when the session runs locally. Takes the fixed floor from 34,817 tokens to 23,736 alone, 5,399 combined with localTools. Never applies to Claude.
//emptyCompletionRetries: Reissue a request that came back with no text and no tool calls. Some local builds do this intermittently and the agent reads the empty turn as a finished one. 0 disables.
//apiTimeoutMs: How long Claude Code waits on one request. Its default expires mid-prefill on a large local model and reads as a hang, while the backend keeps working.
//pricing: Optional, only for cost estimates in `blaude stats`. Blaude ships no guessed prices.
